description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the TextHelperService in the OrangeHRM project. It tests string length, containment, prefix, and suffix functionalities, including Unicode and 8-bit encodings.

classes.name: TextHelperServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test suite for testing TextHelperService functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of TextHelperService before each test.

methods.name: testStrLength
methods.description: Tests the strLength method for ASCII and Unicode strings, including 8-bit encoding.

methods.name: testStrContains
methods.description: Tests whether substrings are correctly identified within strings, including Unicode characters.

methods.name: testStrStartsWith
methods.description: Tests whether strings correctly identify starting substrings.

methods.name: testStrEndsWith
methods.description: Tests whether strings correctly identify ending substrings.
